mapper.select:
WITH selected AS ( SELECT * FROM model_usage_record WHERE enterprise_id = #{filter.enterpriseId} AND dispatched_at >= #{filter.from} AND dispatched_at < #{filter.to} AND model_profile_id = #{filter.modelProfileId} AND user_id = #{filter.userId} AND conversation_id = #{filter.conversationId} AND run_id = #{filter.runId} ), costs AS ( SELECT c.enterprise_id, c.usage_record_id, SUM(c.amount) AS amount FROM model_usage_cost_item c INNER JOIN selected s ON s.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND s.id = c.usage_record_id WHERE s.price_status = 'partial' GROUP BY c.enterprise_id, c.usage_record_id ) SELECT u.currency, d.local_dayNULL AS day, MIN(u.dispatched_at) AS first_request_at, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_status != 'complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_usage_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status IN ('unpriced','partial','invalid') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_status = 'invalid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_usage_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status = 'priced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_price_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_price_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status = 'priced' THEN u.total_amount ELSE NULL END) AS complete_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN u.price_status = 'partial' THEN costs.amount ELSE NULL END) AS partial_amount, SUM(u.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, COUNT(u.input_tokens) AS input_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.input')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.uncached_input_tokens) AS uncachedInput_tokens, COUNT(u.uncached_input_tokens) AS uncachedInput_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.input_uncached')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncachedInput_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, COUNT(u.output_tokens) AS output_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.output')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS output_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.cache_read_tokens) AS cacheRead_tokens, COUNT(u.cache_read_tokens) AS cacheRead_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.cache_read')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cacheRead_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.cache_write_tokens) AS cacheWrite_tokens, COUNT(u.cache_write_tokens) AS cacheWrite_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.cache_write')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cacheWrite_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens, COUNT(u.reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.reasoning')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reasoning_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.tool_use_prompt_tokens) AS toolUsePrompt_tokens, COUNT(u.tool_use_prompt_tokens) AS toolUsePrompt_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.tool_use_prompt')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS toolUsePrompt_not_applicable_calls, SUM(u.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, COUNT(u.total_tokens) AS total_known_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(u.field_states_json, '$.total')) = 'not_applicable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_not_applicable_calls FROM selected u LEFT JOIN costs ON costs.enterprise_id = u.enterprise_id AND costs.usage_record_id = u.id
INNER JOIN (
SELECT #{day.date} AS local_day, #{day.start} AS start_at, #{day.end} AS end_at
) d ON u.dispatched_at >= d.start_at AND u.dispatched_at < d.end_at
GROUP BY u.currency , d.local_day ORDER BY day, u.currency
